_comment: The drop-in registry. DATA, not code — the spine reads this and mounts whatever is here.
Adding a component means adding an entry; it does not mean editing mez_studio.py.
Every entry declares: what it is, which rung it appears on, and HOW THE SPINE REACHES IT.
The spine calls; it never reimplements. That distinction is the whole point: the recurring
defect in this desk has been a capability that exists in the estate and cannot be reached
from here. A component absent from disk is reported as absent, never simulated.
static   a page served from the component's own repo (its studio) — shown in a frame
serve    a local server the component brings; the spine offers to start it, never assumes
cli      a command the component owns; the spine shows the command and runs it on request
panel    the spine's own surface over the component's data (estate, DOI ledger)
dome     the immersive rung: a world config mounted into zistgah/dome

console.title: Console

_note_rungs: C33 / M4: the rung changes what is SHOWN, never what is computed. A console user and a dome
user get the same numbers. Your role selects a default rung; it does not gate a capability.

components.title: The dome
components.what: the shared virtual dome: one library, one world config per zistgah, never a fork
guidance: One library, one world config per zistgah. NEVER a fork.
Any code that branches on world identity is a redundancy defect.
Vehicles swap physics profiles through one flight seam, not three controllers.
The orrery reuses chakra-core's ephemeris — no second ephemeris engine.

components.title: Estate
components.what: the inventory: what exists, where, at what HEAD, in sync or not
components.note: the twelve stages are zops's, called not reimplemented
guidance: The twelve stages are zops's. The spine calls them; it does not reimplement them:
init -> preflight -> clone-or-reuse -> contract -> diff -> gate
-> receipt -> stamp -> reseal -> push -> mark -> done
bash ops/zops.sh                  the library
mez studio doctor                 present, absent, or unreachable
Known live defect: _z_create_remote_if_needed is defined in canonical zops
and never called. Create the remote explicitly before any seal.

components.title: Misty DOI
components.what: mint, version, harvest, walk — the DOI layer
components.note: the interface is read at run time, never recalled. ots takes a subcommand: ots stamp <path>
guidance: misty's interface is READ, never recalled:
misty --help                      the verbs it actually has
misty ots --help                  ots takes a SUBCOMMAND
misty ots stamp <path>            one path, no globs
misty latest -c <concept-doi>     the deposition to version from
misty newversion -r <id> -m meta.json -f artifact --new-version X
A new plate for an existing corpus is a VERSION, not a new deposit.
Splitting a lineage is not undoable without the registrar.

components.title: Genie
components.what: the prompt operating system — build an artifact from nothing
guidance: mez genie cycle                   the eleven nodes
mez genie modes                   ab-initio, ingest, correct
mez genie discover --mode ab-initio --domain "..."
Every prompt creates, verifies, executes, measures, falsifies or integrates
an artifact. None of them merely describes one.
